title: Brew emulated artificer spells without spell slots
message:
Brew emulated artificer spells without spell slots

Artificer Item Creation accepted device spells in can_brew_spell(), but
do_brew() and brew_resolve() still required a prepared spell and spent
its slot, so an artificer could never brew one. One alchemist level also
put the alchemist brewing cap in front of emulation, and every potion of
an artificer with the feat took its artificer level, even for a spell it
brewed through another class.

Emulation is now checked before the alchemist cap, an emulated spell
skips the slot check and spends no slot, and a potion takes the
artificer level only when one of its spells is emulated.

title: Add artificer class help and document devices
message:
Add artificer class help and document devices

class-artificer and artificer-class pointed at the class roster. They
now open an artificer class entry with its features by level. The
DEVICE entry described commands that do not exist; it now lists every
device subcommand and the charge, penalty, and repair rules. The gnome
entry lists Gnomish Tinkering and Brilliance and Blunder. Written to the
dev help DB through the help-sync delta writer and rendered to help.hlp.

Part of #4.

title: Grant the artificer golems, Brilliance and Blunder, and item creation
message:
Grant the artificer golems, Brilliance and Blunder, and item creation

Construct Iron Golem was assigned at artificer 30 on a class that stops
at 20. The golems now come at 10 (wood), 15 (stone), and 20 (iron).

Brilliance and Blunder was the retired Dragonlance gnome's racial, so no
race granted it and its 4-spell devices were unreachable. Gnomes now get
it beside Gnomish Tinkering; existing gnomes receive it on respec.

Artificer Item Creation was checked nowhere. An artificer with it can
brew any wizard or cleric spell of a circle it can put in a device,
without casting it, at its artificer level; the brew's alchemy check is
the emulation roll the feat describes.

Part of #4.

title: Add artificer skill bonuses to craft rolls; fix artificer gear and premade
message:
Add artificer skill bonuses to craft rolls; fix artificer gear and premade

Elbow Grease and the Jack of All Trades line were added only in
compute_ability(), while craft, refine, harvest, brew, and golem checks
read raw ranks through get_craft_skill_value(). The bonuses now live in
artificer_skill_bonus(), which compute_ability() and the new
get_craft_roll_value() both use; rank bookkeeping keeps raw ranks.

newbieEquipment() had no artificer case and logged an invalid class; an
artificer now gets the alchemist kit, which matches its simple weapon
and light armor proficiencies.

The premade artificer bought Craft Magical Arms and Armor and Craft
Wonderous Item, which the class grants free at 5 and 4 (a human bought
the latter twice). It now takes Magical Aptitude, Improved Initiative
for humans, and Empower Spell.

Part of #4.

title: Charge metamagic wand uses, check metamagic UMD, allow device cancel
message:
Charge metamagic wand uses, check metamagic UMD, allow device cancel

Metamagic Science on a wand or staff object spent one charge whatever
metamagic was applied; it now spends one plus the metamagic cost, as
stored wands already did, and refuses when the item holds fewer.

Improved Metamagic Science treated a failed Use Magic Device check as a
pass, because skill_check() returns 0 on failure, not a negative. The
DC is now built from the spell's circle, as the feat describes; stored
potions and scrolls used an unset level of 99, and objects used their
caster level.

device create cancel and device repair cancel were blocked by the wait
device work puts on every other command, so the work could not be
abandoned. They now pass it, and the wait message names them.

Part of #4.

title: Fix artificer device circle checks, device use, and device saves
message:
Fix artificer device circle checks, device use, and device saves

device add compared a class spell level against the circle cap, so a
level 20 artificer could not add any 3rd- or 4th-circle spell. It now
converts to a circle like device create, charges the per-circle slot
budget, and stores the assigned level.

Shared helpers replace six copies of the wizard/cleric level logic:
skills no longer pass as 1st-circle spells, the slot table is read by
level and clamped at 20, and circle slots are assigned by trying every
lower/higher choice, so typed order no longer decides whether a device
fits. Build time follows the assigned levels, a fourth spell without
Brilliance and Blunder is refused instead of dropped, and the free slot
count no longer adds one per existing device.

The per-device cooldown had no writer; its destroy lock, list tag, and
status lines are removed, and device info reads the broken flag. The
destroy warning now states the real 20 minutes.

device use stops casting once the target dies or leaves the room, and
a broken device or failed Use Magic Device check takes the standard
action. A Brilliance and Blunder explosion counts the device's circles
and applies position and death to everyone it hits.

Device saves keep the DC penalty and broken flag on the existing line,
so a broken device no longer comes back working after a relog.
find_skill_num() and find_ability_num() bound each word they copy,
fixing a stack overflow from a long spell word.

Part of #4.
